---
title: "U.S. Counties"
subtitle: "A map of U.S. counties with hidden centroid tooltips."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [U.S. Counties](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/us-county-map.html)
from the mosaic/vgplot example gallery. County name tooltips are
anchored to invisible centroid dot marks. Requires the DuckDB
`spatial` extension.

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "U.S. Counties",
    description = paste(
      "A map of U.S. counties. County name tooltips are anchored to invisible centroid dot",
      "marks. Requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension."
    )
  ) |>
  vg_data(
    name = "counties",
    type = "spatial",
    file = vg_example_url("us-counties-10m.json"),
    layer = "counties"
  ) |>
  vg_data(
    name = "states",
    type = "spatial",
    file = vg_example_url("us-counties-10m.json"),
    layer = "states"
  ) |>
  vg_mark_geo(
    data_from = "counties",
    stroke = "currentColor",
    stroke_width = 0.25
  ) |>
  vg_mark_geo(
    data_from = "states",
    stroke = "currentColor",
    stroke_width = 1
  ) |>
  vg_mark_dot(
    data_from = "counties",
    x = ~ vg_centroid_x(geom),
    y = ~ vg_centroid_y(geom),
    r = 2,
    fill = "transparent",
    tip = TRUE,
    title = ~name
  ) |>
  vg_plot(margin = 0, projection_type = "albers")

vg_render(spec)
```

<details>
<summary>Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec</summary>

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/us-county-map.html) exactly,
aside from `data.counties.file`/`data.states.file` (`vg_example_url()`
vs. a relative path) and object key order.
</details>
